verdict.rationale: RustDesk documents audit logs as a feature of the paid Server Pro tier, along with a web console, so a first-party audit log capability exists for admins. The evidence does not describe what the log records (user, target device, timestamps) or any way to export it, so the core is only implied. Missing for 10: documented log contents showing who connected to which machine and when, a documented export or download of logs for audit, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an IT admin, I can see a log of who connected to which machine and when, exportable for audit

citations.quote: Server Pro adds a web console, device groups, a shared address book, per-user and device-group access control, audit logs, and a management API.
